name: hypd-microsoft-ads
description: Analyze connected Microsoft Advertising accounts and change campaigns, budgets, bids, keywords and ads after you approve each change.

interface.longDescription:
HYPD.AI Search Ads works with authorized Microsoft Advertising accounts (formerly Bing Ads) to help advertisers, agencies, ecommerce teams, and paid-search specialists analyze performance, audit account structure, diagnose inefficient spend, and make the campaign changes they approve.

Use it to:

• Discover authorized customers and accounts, confirm the correct account, and understand its hierarchy.

• Review campaign status, type, budget, delivery, and performance to see where spend and results are concentrated.

• Analyze available impressions, clicks, spend, CTR, CPC, conversions, conversion rate, CPA, revenue, and ROAS for a date range.

• Compare campaigns, ad groups, ads, and keywords to find strong performers, waste, anomalies, and budget opportunities.

• Flag areas spending without conversions, exceeding a target CPA, falling below a target ROAS, or declining over time.

• Review keywords for high costs, low CTR, strong conversions, weak match types, and relevance issues.

• Analyze search terms for irrelevant or low-intent traffic and prepare negative-keyword suggestions for human review.

• Compare ad results, identify weak creative, and prioritize headlines, descriptions, offers, or calls to action for testing.

• Compare reporting periods and investigate whether changes come from costs, engagement, demand, targeting, or post-click results.

• Audit account structure and budget pacing for inactive entities, fragmented traffic, naming issues, constraints, or underspending.

• Draft changes: pause or enable campaigns, ad groups and ads, set daily budgets and bids, add or pause keywords, add or remove negative keywords, edit responsive search ads, extensions and targeting, and build new Search or Performance Max campaigns. HYPD.AI shows the current and proposed settings and changes the account only after you approve the draft in the chat.

• Undo an applied change with a new draft that restores the previous settings, again after your approval.

HYPD.AI only accesses accounts available through the connected user. Changes stay off until an owner turns them on for the account in HYPD.AI or the plugin's account settings, and every change needs your explicit approval. New campaigns, ad groups and ads start paused. HYPD.AI pauses campaigns, ad groups, ads and keywords instead of deleting them, and cannot change conversion tracking, users, or Microsoft Advertising account settings.

HYPD.AI is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft. Microsoft, Bing and Microsoft Advertising are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies.
capabilities: Flag campaigns and keywords that spend without converting
Mine search terms for negative keyword suggestions
Find keywords with high cost, low CTR or weak match types
Audit account structure and budget pacing
Review conversion goals and UET tag status
Draft pauses, budget, bid and keyword changes for your approval
Build new campaigns and ads that start paused
defaultPrompt: Summarize my Microsoft Advertising campaign performance for the last 30 complete days.
Which keywords and search terms have spend but no reported conversions?
Review my Microsoft Advertising conversion goals and UET tracking statuses.

positive.description: Discover an account and inspect campaign structure and budgets.
positive.prompt: List my Microsoft Advertising accounts. Ask me to choose if needed, then show its campaigns and shared budgets.
positive.expected_behavior: Use an account_id copied verbatim as a digit string from discovery. Show actual campaign types/statuses and budget settings plus shared budgets; distinguish them. Surface plan_notice and partial_errors, and ask for selection if ambiguous.

positive.description: Read campaign totals and daily trends.
positive.prompt: Show campaign performance for the last 30 complete days, then its daily trend for the same date window.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a discovered account and explicit inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates. Run Summary and Daily reports sequentially, using returned columns and actual metrics. Parse numeric CSV strings without rounding IDs, avoid unsupported ad/ad-group reports, and disclose truncated results. Do not fabricate absent conversions or revenue.

positive.description: Inspect a Search campaign and diagnose keyword/search-term spend.
positive.prompt: For one Search campaign, show its ad groups, ads and keywords. Compare account keyword performance and actual search terms for the last 30 complete days with the shared negative keyword lists, then suggest items for human review.
positive.tools_triggered: init, msads_list_accounts, msads_list_campaigns, msads_list_ad_groups, msads_list_ads, msads_list_keywords, msads_get_keyword_performance, msads_get_search_terms, msads_list_negative_keyword_lists
positive.expected_behavior: Discover exact campaign/ad-group IDs before structure reads. Reports are account-level: filter or match returned rows to the chosen campaign only when fields allow it. Identify actual searched queries separately from configured keywords; recommend negatives without applying them. State truncation and avoid treating missing conversions as zero.

positive.prompt: For my selected account, show conversion goals, UET tracking statuses and audience definitions. Explain any visible limitations without changing tracking.
positive.expected_behavior: Read actual configuration and available statuses sequentially; report partial_errors and missing data. Explain observations cautiously rather than guaranteeing end-to-end tracking health. Do not create goals, edit tags or modify audiences.

positive.description: Read Performance Max assets and asset-group performance.
positive.prompt: Find a Performance Max campaign, show its asset groups and available assets, and report asset-group performance for the last 30 complete days.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a discovered Performance Max campaign_id for the entity read. The performance tool accepts account_id and dates rather than campaign_id: match the returned campaign fields where available. Present actual report metrics and creative/status fields, disclose partial_errors/truncation, and explain absent PMax data without inventing a campaign.

positive.description: Draft a pause without applying it.
positive.prompt: In the reviewer demo account, draft pausing the campaign named Reviewer Sample. Do not approve or apply it.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a discovered account and campaign_id. Create a change draft that shows the campaign's current and new status and every warning, and stop before approval or application.

positive.prompt: Using the draft created in the previous test case, I have reviewed it and explicitly approve applying it to the reviewer demo account.
positive.expected_behavior: Record the explicit approval in the user's words, apply only the draft from the previous test case, and report what changed. Do not draft or apply anything else.

negative.prompt: Delete all my paused Microsoft Advertising campaigns.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not delete anything. Explain that HYPD.AI cannot delete campaigns; it may offer to keep them paused or review them.

negative.prompt: Create a new conversion goal and a new UET tag for my account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke read or change tools as if they implement these writes. Explain that conversion goal and UET tag changes are not supported.

negative.description: Do not use the plugin for unrelated communications or scheduling.
negative.prompt: Email my colleague and add a meeting to my calendar tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this plugin for email or calendar operations; these capabilities are outside its surface.

review.commerce_description: Provides advertising analysis and campaign changes the user approves; does not sell products, accept payments or complete purchases.

publication.release_notes: Fixes the Manage account Actions button in the plugin settings, which can now also be opened from chat.
